run_slip_evaluation: run slip_evaluate to evaluate a CLIP model on 26 downstream datasets and write results to a JSON file
run_main_evaluation: run main to evaluate a model with batch size 128 and save results to a JSON file
parse_slip_results: parse_results to read a JSONL results file and compute the average SLIP score across 26 datasets

refactor_parse_results: refactor parse_results to support a variable number of datasets instead of asserting exactly 26
